# OpenPGP fixtures

Synthetic keys and messages for the `fm-pgp` tests. Every person, address and
passphrase here is made up; none of these keys is used anywhere else.

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `ann.pub.asc`, `ann.sec.asc` | Ann Example, generated by `fm_pgp::generate` (Ed25519 with a Curve25519 subkey, no expiry). The secret key is exported with `fm_pgp::export_secret`, passphrase `fixture passphrase ann`. |
| `gus.pub.asc`, `gus.sec.asc` | Gus GnuPG, generated by GnuPG 2.4.8 (`--quick-gen-key ... ed25519 sign,cert never`, then a `cv25519 encr` subkey). Passphrase `fixture passphrase gus`. |
| `rita.pub.asc`, `rita.sec.asc` | Rita RSA, generated by GnuPG 2.4.8 (RSA 3072 sign/certify key and RSA 3072 encryption subkey). Passphrase `fixture passphrase rita`. |
| `gus-to-ann-encrypted.eml` | PGP/MIME, encrypted to Ann and signed by Gus with `gpg --sign --encrypt`. Inside: `multipart/mixed` with a text part and `plan.txt`. |
| `gus-signed.eml` | PGP/MIME `multipart/signed` by Gus, `gpg --detach-sign --digest-algo SHA256` over a `multipart/alternative` entity. |
| `gus-to-ann-inline.eml` | Inline armored message, encrypted to Ann and signed by Gus, between two lines of plain text. |
| `gus-cleartext.eml` | Inline `gpg --clearsign` text with a dash-escaped line. |
| `gus-to-rita-encrypted.eml` | PGP/MIME encrypted to Rita's RSA key only, unsigned. |

The keys were made in a throwaway `GNUPGHOME`; the messages were assembled by
hand around GnuPG's output, with CRLF line endings.
